panels.title: Spike Detection Algorithm
panels.body:
score = (current_count - avg_24h) / std_dev_24h

If score > 5.0 AND count > 1000:
  Mark as Trending Candidate

Apply Time Decay:
  final_score = score * e^(-lambda * age)
